name: silver-bullet
description: Agentic Process Orchestrator for AI-native Software Engineering & DevOps. SB's Codex package contains Silver Bullet-owned skills, hooks, and templates only; GSD and selected helper plugins are installed from their official sources.

interface.longDescription: Silver Bullet layers SB-owned skills, hooks, and workflow assets onto Codex and Claude Code to compose task-shaped workflows around GSD. Third-party dependencies are installed from their own sources rather than vendored into the SB Codex bundle.
